pStyliqueSolution: Built a 3D generative AI try-on pipeline with Stable Diffusion, reducing returns by 25%.

pDressifySolution: Engineered a multimodal neural engine using CLIP and ViT for style recommendation.

pCarepulseSolution: Created patient intake automation with Twilio SMS reminders and active queue management.

pGitSmartSolution: Created a Node.js CLI utilizing Inquirer and Chalk to automate branch staging and merges.
